card.name: Linking words before measured-outcome terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation ("(", "of", "by", "in") right before a measurement term such as AUC, FEV 1, prednisone or glycemic. Also partway through words like glycemic and hypoglycemia.

modes.label: Bracket or link before a measure
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or small word just before an abbreviation naming an exposure or lung-function measure.
modes.example: The mean systemic exposure<< (>>AUC) of etravir

modes.label: Inside glycemia words
modes.description: Partway through glycemic or hypoglycemia in diabetes text.

modes.label: Unit or link after a dose
modes.description: A unit or small word after a number, before the named drug or measure.
modes.example: taking more than 600<< mg>> of the levodopa component per day

card.writes: It seems to push toward the start of a measure or drug name, such as Pred or Poss, and away from unrelated code-like pieces.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or bracket just before a lab or exposure measure or a named drug is given.
